title: Categorical cancellation for the transpose retraction
statement: Given a restriction internal-Hom isomorphism family e, a local section s of f, the composite of the restricted transpose with the conjugated precomposition map is the identity.

proof.text: Expand the naturality equation of the internal-Hom restriction isomorphisms, then compose with precomposition by s. Contravariant functoriality of homObjMap reduces the composite to precomposition by s followed by f, which is the identity by hs. The detailed reassociation and cancellation are postponed in this intermediate theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem dual_retraction_key
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {P Q : X.Modules} (f : P ⟶ Q) (U : X.Opens)
    (s : (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj Q ⟶ (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj P)
    (e : ∀ A B : X.Modules,
      (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj (SheafOfModules.homObj
        (R := X.toRingedSpace.sheaf) A B) ≅
        SheafOfModules.homObj (R := U.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf)
          ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj A) ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj B))
    (hs : s ≫ (restrictFunctor U.ι).map f = 𝟙 _) :
    (restrictFunctor U.ι).map (dualMap f) ≫
        (e P (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).hom ≫
        SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := U.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf)
          s (𝟙 _) ≫ (e Q (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).inv = 𝟙 _
